name: test-kept-declaration-beside-dead-production-references
description: A declaration whose production references are all made by dead code, and that a test which tests live code references, is kept by that test, so it is reported as test-only use rather than as code only dead declarations reference; one only dead code references is reported as such. test-only-use-beside-dead-production-references pins the same rule where a TypeScript cap lowers the confidence of both.
